intro_heading: We manage the airspace in Finland and provide en-route and air navigation services at 22 airports on the VATSIM network.
intro_content: Our team is dedicated to providing realistic and outstanding ATC service. We offer high-quality ATC training, well-structured manuals, and a modern, dynamic working environment. Additionally, we develop various apps to support both controlling and flying in Finland.

wth_subtitle: Join us every Thursday at our main hub, Helsinki!
wth_desc: A rapidly growing team of controllers is looking forward to guiding you into Helsinki Airport (EFHK). Helsinki Control (EFIN_CTR) will also provide top-down service all across Finnish airspace. We guarantee professional, flexible and friendly service across the entirety of Finland.
wth_desc2: The event lasts for 3 hours starting at 1800z (1700z during Summer)
lapland_subtitle: Experience Lapland during the Winter Season!
lapland_desc: See and touch the magic of Lapland every Tuesday during the Winter Season! Three of Lapland's biggest airports are fully staffed and serving virtual Lapland travellers the whole winter season!
lapland_desc2: The event lasts for 3 hours starting at 1700z
fss_desc: Fly and See Santa, the largest annual Christmas event in VATSIM skies, takes place at three airports in the northernmost reaches of Europe. Experience the magic of snow-covered landscapes and icy runways as you arrive at Rovaniemi, Tromsø, and Kiruna—airports nestled in the stunning wilderness of northern Europe. Throughout December, the airspace buzzes with flights full of passengers eager to visit Santa's winter wonderland. We hope you’ll join us for this unforgettable event!
service_type1: Either combined or separate aerodrome and approach control service based on the use of ATS surveillance systems.
service_type2: Aerodrome and approach control services based on the use of ATS surveillance systems.
service_type3: Combined aerodrome and approach control service based on the use of ATS surveillance systems (R TWR).
service_type4: Combined aerodrome and approach control service based on the use of procedural control (P TWR).
pilot_links_desc1: Want to fly in Finland like a pro? Explore these useful websites!
pilot_links_desc2: Also, please join our Discord server to chat, connect, and engage with fellow aviation enthusiasts. Whether you have questions, want to engage in conversations, or simply enjoy the company while flying or controlling, our community offers a welcoming space for all.
lusep_1: Lusep is a TMA entry point for Helsinki Airport (EFHK). It is located on the northern boundary of the Helsinki Terminal Area. Lusep also functions as a standard holding area when arrivals become too busy.
lusep_2: Maybe plan your next flight via Lusep?
lusep_3: The Lusep.fi domain is primarily used for tools designed for ATC operations and management. This is not an official VATSIM website.
lusep_4: We are part of VATSIM Scandinavia and VATEUD.
atc_doc_authentication: Some of the web applications require VATSIM authentication.
footer_sim_use_only: Intended for simulator use only on VATSIM network.
footer_newsletter_desc: Get the latest updates and news for Finland by subscribing to our newsletter.
